audience.programmeDescription: VU Communication and Information Studies examines language, media and communication. Its Media and Journalism route combines media analysis, rhetoric, journalism practice, research methods and an individual thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: VU’s published course allocation totals 180 EC. One required course has a prerequisite outside the route table. The curriculum below shows the published allocation while the applicable progression rule is being confirmed.

curriculum.limitation: The allocation includes 30 EC of open study. Discourse and Social Interaction requires a pass in Discourse Analysis, which is absent from the route table. VU’s provisional 2027–2028 list shows a revised second year. The approved requirements for this cohort still need confirmation. The thesis and colloquium require completion of years one and two. Orientation and the language test carry no credit.

componentNotes.y3-01: Open 30 EC: an approved minor, approved free choices with at least 12 EC at advanced level, or a permitted internship and courses.
componentNotes.y2-03: The current entry requirement is a pass in Discourse Analysis. The route table does not list that prerequisite.
componentNotes.y3-05: A 3 EC parallel colloquium: organize a symposium, present thesis research and write a public-facing science piece. All components must pass.
componentNotes.y3-06: A 9 EC individual research thesis within a supervised theme group. Mandatory meetings, an approved work plan and a progress decision apply; supervisor and second reader assess independently.
